purpose.primary: Store a runtime-sized sequence while making allocator ownership, checked growth, cleanup, and reallocation invalidation explicit.

c_pain.summary: C growable arrays concentrate overflow, realloc failure, stale-pointer, and cleanup hazards in deceptively small code.
common_failure_modes: losing the original pointer after failed realloc
c_pain.why_c_is_attractive: A pointer, length, capacity, and realloc loop produce a fast compact container.
c_pain.where_c_degrades: Every added requirement multiplies informal ownership, failure ordering, and invalidation rules.

zig_response.summary: An allocator is stored explicitly; growth uses checked arithmetic and replacement-before-commit semantics.
guarantees_made_visible: initialized values are exposed as slices
remaining_programmer_responsibilities: clean element-owned resources before container cleanup
